verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe issue-to-PR automation (reading issues, writing code, running tests, submitting PRs; JIRA/GitHub integration; Slack bug-report-to-PR flow; @claude tagging on GitHub), directly matching the story. However, community reports raise real caveats about reliability and self-verification (e.g., destructive replace_all bugs, 'simplest fix' producing broken code, high failure rates for some users), suggesting the end-to-end flow works but often needs human review/iteration rather than being fully autonomous.
